audit.reasoning: The coding (fixed final, dominant not strict) rests on the only full grammar of this extinct language (Alexander-Bakkerus 2005, 533 pp), which relays the 1748 grammarian's explicit rule ('only one accent, on the last syllable, in nouns as well as in verbs') and his stress diacritics, and is corroborated by the author's own rememberer recordings (final stress unmarked by default). Full text was not held before; it is now fetched sources (LOT open access) and the quotation is confirmed verbatim at p.79 (locator should read p.79, sec. 4.2.7.5, not p.80; second passage pp.106-107 sec. 4.5 confirmed). The record's grade field is blank and the cited PuRe file is only front matter, so: point the citation at the LOT full text, fix the page, and grade it as a verbatim-confirmed primary statement. Optional refinement for the domain/caution field: de la Mata also notes penultimate accent 'en algunos tiempo
